name: gitlab
purpose: Projects, merge requests and issues on gitlab.com

apiKey.name: PRIVATE-TOKEN
apiKey.help: gitlab.com → Preferences → Access tokens (scope read_api, or api for changes)

guide:
The GitLab REST API v4 (https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/rest/), as the person.

```sh
curl -s https://gitlab.com/api/v4/user
curl -s 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/merge_requests?scope=assigned_to_me&state=opened'
curl -s 'https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/GROUP%2FPROJECT/issues?state=opened&per_page=20'
```

A comment, a merge or a new issue asks the person first unless they allowed changes.
